summary: Pilot-only nested CV round 2: k tuned inside CV, pairwise/triple/sign products and k-means-distance L1 designs
reasoning: Explore1 (pilot only, 2x5 nested CV): best was F-top-10 + pairwise products at 0.685, mains-only F10 0.662, all engineered variants below 0.69 — short of the 0.71 floor. Clear monotone trend: smaller k better; pairwise products add ~0.02 over mains. Next pilot-only round explores stronger but still L1-compatible feature spaces, now tuning k inside the inner CV: (a) pairwise products with k tuned in {6,8,10,12,15}; (b) binarized sign pairs, same k grid; (c) mains+pairs+sign-pairs; (d) mains+pairs+triples on top-8; (e) k-means distance/RBF features over top-20 (motivated by the vote trail's Manhattan-KNN success). Current working expectation (informal, not declared): at least one variant's nested CV approaches or passes 0.71; mains-limited ceiling is evidently ~0.66-0.69, so if interactions cannot reach ~0.71 the L1 route would need a different judgement. Heldout.csv stays unopened.
